title: Rent tab financial-year grouping
description: Group rental payments and operating expenses on a property's Rent tab into financial-year sections, using sticky subtotal dividers over one continuous list.

context.layout_decision: Sticky FY divider rows, no collapsing — whole history stays visible
context.fy_basis: payment_date / expense_date, matching the ATO cash basis and the tax pack
context.key_risk: overflow-x-auto wrapper in rental-payments-section.tsx defeats position:sticky
context.divider_fill: --landing-warm, reused from the landing palette; additive token, has a dark value
context.outstanding: AC2/AC3/AC11 (dividers rendering, pinning while scrolling, light/dark and mobile legibility) were never verified by the agent — the Rent tab is auth-gated and it could not authenticate.
